items.reason: Detail `s` opens the same kind-derived Status menu over the detail’s container.
Detail `y` opens the container’s Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail `m` opens the Mute menu over the detail’s container.
Detail and row-list `I` share the same runFlatVerb dispatch.
View returns the detail before rendering drainPick, leaving the opened drain picker invisible.
Peek handling removes both flat copy-key routes.
Neither detail list handles the flat `p` key.
Existing item and artifact `r` menu routes remain intact, including peeks.
The shared status refusal reaches the detail hint line through the dashboard flash fallback.
The shared copy refusal reaches the detail hint line through the dashboard flash fallback.
The shared mute refusal reaches the detail hint line through the dashboard flash fallback.
Container menus occupy Frame.Block, whose height is deducted from the list’s available space.
Detail menus delegate navigation and entry dispatch to the existing row-list menu handlers.
Menu Esc clears the menu while retaining the detail.
Detail openers bypass Selection and create singular menus targeting their container.
Detail search filters the displayed list, and Enter restores normal detail handling.
Shared filtering ANDs case-insensitive substring terms across item ID, title and type.
Item search fields exclude status.
Artifact filtering uses the same grammar over name and type.
Search Esc restores the previously applied term and its filtered lists.
Reopening search creates an empty buffer; applying it restores all rows.
The typing handler routes ordinary keys, including `j`, `k`, `v` and `r`, into the text field.
Detail refresh reapplies the active query instead of replacing it.
The detail header displays the applied search term.
Empty search results name the term and explain `/` then Enter to clear.
Artifact availability uses the complete artifact collection, preserving list switching after filtering.
Detail search owns separate state that disappears when the detail closes.
Detail hints advertise `r`, `s`, `y`, `m` and `/`, with flat copy hints removed.
Peek hints no longer advertise flat name or path copying.
Typing hints name only apply search, cancel and help.
Detail help includes the menus, applicable `I`, search and conditional clearing; peek help removes flat copying.
Help distinguishes container menus over details and includes a dedicated detail-search typing branch.

scores.rationale: Clear shared implementation and useful regression tests, but missing drain-picker rendering and coverage leave a significant interaction broken.
